# Vendor Assets

This directory contains self-contained third-party client-side libraries bundled with EPES to avoid external CDN runtime dependencies and ensure deterministic browser rendering.

| Asset File | Version | Upstream Package | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bootstrap.min.css` | 5.3.3 | [Bootstrap](https://getbootstrap.com/) | MIT |
| `bootstrap.bundle.min.js` | 5.3.3 | [Bootstrap](https://getbootstrap.com/) | MIT |
| `chart.umd.js` | 4.4.7 | [Chart.js](https://www.chartjs.org/) | MIT |

Source: Pinned distributions downloaded from `cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/`.
License headers are retained in the respective minified source files.
